title: Empathy or Not?
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Classify eight replies to a teacher who fears losing their job as dismissive, defensive, reassurance without substance, or empathic and substantive.

learningObjectives: The learner will classify eight replies to a worried teacher as dismissive, defensive, reassurance without substance, or empathic and substantive, correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: Responding with empathy, legitimate concern, and fear of job loss, from the section "Resistance, Concerns, and Job Fears" in Chapter 19.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify one item at a time with immediate feedback; first-attempt scoring
keyQuestions: Does the reply acknowledge the worry?
Does it offer a fact, an option, or a commitment?
commonMisconceptions: Reassurance is the same as empathy.
assessmentOpportunities: "I understand, I'm sure you'll be fine." What kind of reply is this?
Is every reply that disagrees with the teacher defensive?
What two things does an empathic and substantive reply do?

controls.name: Category buttons
controls.description: Choose the kind of reply for the current reply.

controls.name: Submit
controls.description: Checks the choice. Two tries per reply; only the first counts.

controls.name: Next
controls.description: Moves to the next reply. Finish shows the score.

controls.name: Start over
controls.description: Reshuffles and begins a new run.
